notes: Seeded detection corpus for the security persona (2026-08-19 eval-suite expansion).
Before this file, only the testing persona had a structural detection eval; every other
persona's charter had zero regression coverage against a real diff. This is a first,
deliberately small pass at the security persona using the same self-contained-diff,
AND-of-OR mustMatch grading evaluate-testing-charter.mjs already uses -- no code changes
were needed, only a fixture file, since the script resolves persona and fixtures generically
Run candidate-only (there is no charter rewrite here to A/B against a baseline snapshot):
Each defect fixture is paired with a near-miss clean control shaped to trip a reviewer that
flags on surface pattern (string interpolation in a query, a WHERE clause with fewer columns)
rather than the actual missing-parameterisation or missing-tenant-scope rule.

fixtures.title: Add a status filter to the order search query
fixtures.summary: A parameterised query is rewritten as a template literal that interpolates the caller-supplied search term directly into the SQL text, turning a safe query into a SQL-injection sink.

fixtures.title: Simplify the invoice lookup to a single primary-key fetch
fixtures.summary: The org_id scoping predicate is dropped from the invoice query, so any authenticated caller can fetch any other organisation's invoice by guessing or enumerating its id.

fixtures.title: Return the order status alongside id and total
fixtures.summary: Control: adds a selected column to an already-parameterised query. The parameter list and placeholders are untouched; nothing user-controlled changes shape. A reviewer that flags any touched db.query() call regardless of what changed would false-positive here.

fixtures.title: Extract the invoice query into a named helper
fixtures.summary: Control: the org_id scoping predicate is preserved verbatim across the extraction into buildInvoiceQuery(); only the call shape changes. Nothing to flag.
